lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Morning. It's Monday, Oct 19, and you're the HCM for the Office of Learning Operations. This week, everything lands at once: hiring, pay, changes, leave, costing, students, and records.
lines.say: Morning. It's Monday, October nineteenth, and you're the HCM for the Office of Learning Operations. This week, everything lands at once: hiring, pay, changes, leave, costing, students, and records.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Three payroll calendars run this week, and the right one depends on the worker. Exempt staff are paid monthly, and October's cutoff passed on the 18th. Hourly staff are paid weekly or biweekly: backdated changes close Wednesday, other changes Friday at 5:00 PM, and time cards are due Monday at noon.
lines.say: Three payroll calendars run this week, and the right one depends on the worker. Exempt staff are paid monthly, and October's cutoff passed on the eighteenth. Hourly staff are paid weekly or biweekly: backdated changes close Wednesday, other changes Friday at five P M, and time cards are due Monday at noon.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Your job: get every request to the right outcome, through the right person, before its deadline. Managers own their team's time and approvals. Central HR, payroll, and your EC own theirs. You make sure it all lands.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Requests and quick questions arrive all week. Some are urgent; some are noise. On pay day, Friday Oct 30, you'll see what every decision did.
lines.say: Requests and quick questions arrive all week. Some are urgent; some are noise. On pay day, Friday October thirtieth, you'll see what every decision did.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Three payroll calendars run this week, and the one that applies depends on the worker. Before you open anything, walk me through them.

lines.speaker: dir_park
lines.text: Our evaluator needs CampusHR access while she's here. How do we set her up?
lines.say: Our evaluator needs Campus H R access while she's here. How do we set her up?

lines.speaker: mgr_bell
lines.text: Noor accepted! Can she start Wednesday? We'll do the paperwork after.

lines.speaker: emp_nair
lines.text: My dad has surgery next week and I'll be caring for him, so I may need days off, on and off, for a few weeks. What do I do?

lines.speaker: mgr_ortiz
lines.text: If someone on my team resigns, which dates do you need from me?

lines.speaker: emp_grant
lines.text: Maya worked 12 hours at the fall event and she was amazing. Can I just pay her with a $150 gift card from the event budget?
lines.say: Maya worked twelve hours at the fall event and she was amazing. Can I just pay her with a one hundred fifty dollar gift card from the event budget?

lines.speaker: mgr_ortiz
lines.text: I found our old Events Coordinator position from 2019. Can you switch it back on and get it posted this week?
lines.say: I found our old Events Coordinator position from twenty nineteen. Can you switch it back on and get it posted this week?

lines.speaker: mgr_ortiz
lines.text: Kai's record shows a second job with some other manager. Is that a mistake we should fix?

lines.speaker: emp_chen
lines.text: I'm taking this Friday off. Can you put it on the time card system for me, like everyone else's?

lines.speaker: emp_grant
lines.text: A student we invited to our forum paid $80 for her train ticket. How do we pay her back?
lines.say: A student we invited to our forum paid eighty dollars for her train ticket. How do we pay her back?

lines.speaker: dir_park
lines.text: Did you see my email? I need that spreadsheet for the grant report by noon tomorrow.

lines.speaker: mgr_ortiz
lines.text: If we post it as Campus Events Coordinator, is that the title the new hire gets in CampusHR?
lines.say: If we post it as Campus Events Coordinator, is that the title the new hire gets in Campus H R?

lines.speaker: mgr_ortiz
lines.text: Sam's new title still isn't showing. Did my change get lost, or should we just enter it again?

lines.speaker: mgr_bell
lines.text: She was great. Can't we just change that to Yes and make the offer?

lines.speaker: dir_park
lines.text: If one of my managers leaves, how do we move their whole team to someone new?

lines.speaker: mgr_bell
lines.text: Aisha's going to 30 hours a week starting next pay period. I told her payroll would take care of it, so can you give them a heads up?
lines.say: Aisha's going to thirty hours a week starting next pay period. I told her payroll would take care of it, so can you give them a heads up?

lines.speaker: mgr_ortiz
lines.text: Dr. Park approved a home office payment for Mei. She should take home exactly $500. How will you set it up?
lines.say: Dr. Park approved a home office payment for Mei. She should take home exactly five hundred dollars. How will you set it up?

lines.speaker: dir_park
lines.text: Let's have her handle our regular data entry, 15 hours a week from January to May, unpaid. It's great experience for her, and it saves us budget.
lines.say: Let's have her handle our regular data entry, fifteen hours a week from January to May, unpaid. It's great experience for her, and it saves us budget.

lines.speaker: fin_weiss
lines.text: Our grant pays a graduate fellow a $1,000 stipend this term, with no work attached. How will you set her up?
lines.say: Our grant pays a graduate fellow a one thousand dollar stipend this term, with no work attached. How will you set her up?

lines.speaker: dir_park
lines.text: Can you pull me a roster from CampusHR with names, titles, and managers for Monday's org chart? Make sure Noor is on it.
lines.say: Can you pull me a roster from Campus H R with names, titles, and managers for Monday's org chart? Make sure Noor is on it.

lines.speaker: dir_park
lines.text: Can you open a requisition so my search firm can get started?

lines.speaker: emp_chen
lines.text: Lena's September pay charged 100% to our department, and the grant should have paid half. Can we still fix it, or is September a lost cause?
lines.say: Lena's September pay charged one hundred percent to our department, and the grant should have paid half. Can we still fix it, or is September a lost cause?

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Four Kowalskis came back. How do you make sure you open the right one?

lines.speaker: mgr_bell
lines.text: Jordan's raise finally came through. The approval letter's attached. Can you get it in before Friday's cutoff?

lines.speaker: mgr_bell
lines.text: She already works here. Do I hire her into the program job like anyone else?

lines.speaker: ec_menon
lines.text: Dev Patel still shows active and payable in your office, but his summer work ended in August. Can you close that out this week?

lines.speaker: rec_nguyen
lines.text: Sam accepted our Data Assistant II offer in the other school, effective Sun Nov 8. I wanted you to hear it from me first.
lines.say: Sam accepted our Data Assistant II offer in the other school, effective Sunday, November eighth. I wanted you to hear it from me first.

lines.speaker: mgr_bell
lines.text: If it is union, can I still offer a couple of dollars over the contract rate to get someone good?

lines.speaker: mgr_bell
lines.text: Cutoff's Friday at five, right? So if I send you changes Friday afternoon, they still make this payroll?

lines.speaker: dir_park
lines.text: Our new lecturer wants to start Nov 2, but her background check isn't back. Faculty don't need one, right?
lines.say: Our new lecturer wants to start November second, but her background check isn't back. Faculty don't need one, right?

lines.speaker: emp_okafor
lines.text: My time card is all filled in through today. Should I hit Submit now, so it's in before the weekend?

lines.speaker: dir_park
lines.text: Samuel is leading our workshop series through December. Put him on a staff supplement, $500 a month, starting this month.
lines.say: Samuel is leading our workshop series through December. Put him on a staff supplement, five hundred dollars a month, starting this month.

lines.speaker: mgr_ortiz
lines.text: Do we build Lena a new position for this, or is it a change to the one she's in?

lines.speaker: mgr_ortiz
lines.text: Sam's move went through central recruiting. Does my January move go to them too?

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Week two time cards are still in progress. Let's get a reminder out, so everything's approved by Monday at noon.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Your weekly check turned up three exceptions. Remember, managers review their own team's time. Spot the problem, get it to the right manager, and help them fix it.

lines.speaker: dir_park
lines.text: Does the posting have to show a pay range? We usually leave pay off.

lines.speaker: pay_liu
lines.text: Marcus Bell's retention increase failed in CampusHR after it was approved. His September pay used his old salary, and October's will too. Get me what I need by Friday at noon, and I can pay him in this week's off-cycle run.
lines.say: Marcus Bell's retention increase failed in Campus H R after it was approved. His September pay used his old salary, and October's will too. Get me what I need by Friday at noon, and I can pay him in this week's off-cycle run.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Hi, I'm Maya Brooks's parent, and she isn't answering her phone. Can you look up her class schedule so I know when to reach her?

lines.speaker: dir_park
lines.text: Marcus will cover extra duties while I chair a campus task force, $800 a month. Nobody knows when it ends. What end date goes in?
lines.say: Marcus will cover extra duties while I chair a campus task force, eight hundred dollars a month. Nobody knows when it ends. What end date goes in?

lines.speaker: emp_chen
lines.text: Noor's position is half Wellness grant, and her costing looks blank to me. Is that a problem before Monday?

lines.speaker: emp_brennan
lines.text: I sent Dana my resignation this morning. My last day here is Friday the 30th, but I'm keeping my teaching job in the School of Education.
lines.say: I sent Dana my resignation this morning. My last day here is Friday the thirtieth, but I'm keeping my teaching job in the School of Education.

lines.speaker: mgr_ortiz
lines.text: A professor with a joint appointment here retires in December and becomes emeritus. Can you reuse her faculty position for that?

lines.speaker: dir_park
lines.text: She'd rather invoice us as a contractor. That's simpler for everyone, isn't it?

lines.speaker: mgr_bell
lines.text: If I had to fire someone for misconduct, could you terminate them today and cut their access right away?

lines.speaker: mgr_bell
lines.text: Here's Jordan's signed raise letter, plus the unsigned draft. Do these go to payroll for his back pay, or what?

lines.speaker: mgr_bell
lines.text: I got a form for a FERDC appointment starting in January. Can you set it up like Dr. Osei's record?
lines.say: I got a form for an F E R D C appointment starting in January. Can you set it up like Doctor Osei's record?

lines.speaker: mgr_bell
lines.text: Good news: Noor's moving to Illinois in January, and I told her she can work remotely from there. Anything you need from me?

lines.speaker: mgr_bell
lines.text: Noor wants to know if Illinois sick leave rules will apply to her. What should I tell her?

lines.speaker: emp_chen
lines.text: Once Sam moves on November 8, our account stops paying for him on its own, right? I just want to be sure.
lines.say: Once Sam moves on November eighth, our account stops paying for him on its own, right? I just want to be sure.

lines.speaker: emp_rivera
lines.text: I'm back at work Monday. Marcus says CampusHR still shows me on leave, so he told me to check with you.
lines.say: I'm back at work Monday. Marcus says Campus H R still shows me on leave, so he told me to check with you.

lines.speaker: dir_park
lines.text: If we eliminate a position, how much notice do we owe, and when is the person's last day?

lines.speaker: emp_chen
lines.text: Is there one report that shows costing for everyone in our office, or do we open each record?

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: It's Monday, and time cards are due at noon. Marcus still has three waiting on him.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Noor's here at nine, and it's time card morning too. What has to happen for her today, and what can wait?

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Before payroll signs off at noon, check the totals one more time. Lena updated her time card Thursday night.

lines.speaker: mgr_ortiz
lines.text: My Nov 6 day off is approved, but now I have to work that day. Can you just delete it?
lines.say: My November sixth day off is approved, but now I have to work that day. Can you just delete it?

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Marcus just set his out of office. He's out sick today, and his team's time cards are still waiting.

lines.speaker: rec_nguyen
lines.text: Noor's offer letter promised a $1,000 sign-on bonus, but I left it off her offer in CampusHR. Can you add it on your side?
lines.say: Noor's offer letter promised a one thousand dollar sign-on bonus, but I left it off her offer in Campus H R. Can you add it on your side?

lines.speaker: dir_park
lines.text: I have a budget meeting at eleven, and I need a headcount report for the department. Can you have it to me in an hour?

lines.speaker: mgr_ortiz
lines.text: Priya says she'll need some time off next week. Is everything okay? What's going on with her?

lines.speaker: mgr_ortiz
lines.text: Hold on, it says Asistant, with one s. Can we fix that?

lines.speaker: dir_park
lines.text: If Noor isn't in CampusHR yet, just type her in. The chart can't miss her.
lines.say: If Noor isn't in Campus H R yet, just type her in. The chart can't miss her.

lines.speaker: mgr_ortiz
lines.text: Priya put down 44 hours in week 1, and I never approved overtime. Can I just change her time to 40?
lines.say: Priya put down forty-four hours in week one, and I never approved overtime. Can I just change her time to forty?

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Fine. Then just tell me how many hours she worked for you and what she's being paid.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Which calendar pays this worker? Start there, then find the cutoff on that calendar.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Which setup is built for people the office never pays, and what does that setup leave out?

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: What has to arrive before anyone can start work here, and what do you do once it comes?

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Who decides whether a leave like this is protected, and what clock starts once the office hears about it?

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: A resignation has two key dates. What does each one mark?

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: If Maya did work the office directed, what does that make her, and how does anyone in that role get paid?

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: What could an old position carry into a new hire, and what does central HR need to see before it approves a staff position?

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Where does a manager live in CampusHR: on the person, or somewhere more specific?
lines.say: Where does a manager live in Campus H R: on the person, or somewhere more specific?

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: What does Mei's pay type tell you about where her time off belongs, and who has to act before it counts?

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Is this student being paid for work, or only paid back for what she spent?

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: If this spreadsheet landed in the wrong inbox, what would be in it?

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: What does a six-digit job code bring with it, besides a pay range?

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Before you redo anything, what would tell you where the first change is right now?

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Where did that No come from, and who has to look at it with you?

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: What happens to approvals while a team is still attached to someone who is gone?

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: What does payroll pay from, and who changes it? Then look at Aisha's calendar: when does her next pay period start?

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Is $500 what Mei takes home, or what she's paid before taxes? And which payroll month can it still make?
lines.say: Is five hundred dollars what Mei takes home, or what she's paid before taxes? And which payroll month can it still make?

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: In this setup, who gets the most out of it: the student or the office?

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Does the fellow do any work for the money? Which setup fits a payment with no services?

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: CampusHR keeps every change with a date. Which date is Dr. Park's chart about?
lines.say: Campus H R keeps every change with a date. Which date is Dr. Park's chart about?

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: How does an outside firm get paid, and who should hear about an executive search first?

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: In the History, which record is wrong, and for how much of its range? Then check the calendar for the cutoff that applies to periods already paid.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Names and titles repeat across campus. What does CampusHR give each person that never repeats?
lines.say: Names and titles repeat across campus. What does Campus H R give each person that never repeats?

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: The approval letter answers both fields. Copy, don't calculate. Then check: which cutoff applies to a backdated change?

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Payroll can only pay what your hire record says. What does a non-exempt hire need on hers?

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: What does her record already have, and what should the new job get of its own?

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Is Dev leaving every job he has, or only yours? And when did his work with you really stop?

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: How did Sam's move start, and who owns moves that start that way? Then ask what is really happening to his job.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: If a contract covers this job, who set its pay, and who can change it?

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Picture the change at 4:59 PM Friday. Who still has to touch it?
lines.say: Picture the change at four fifty-nine P M Friday. Who still has to touch it?

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Which worker types skip the background check, and is faculty one of them?

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Is the pay period over yet? What happens if Sam submits now and then works Thursday and Friday?

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: What kind of worker is Dr. Osei, and which payments and which calendar fit that kind of worker?

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Is this a new role, or the same role changing? And what does a position push to the person in it?

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Compare how this move started with how Sam's started. Then ask which action is built for a change of position.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Who has to act before Monday at noon? It isn't only the employees.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: For each exception, ask: whose employee is this, and what does that manager need from you to fix it?

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: What does the location on a position decide for its posting?

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Payroll can only pay what's on the record. What has to be on Marcus's record before Grace can pay him?

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Maya is a college student. Who decides what her school shares about her?

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: A recurring payment keeps paying until something stops it. If nobody knows the end date, what stops this one?

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: What does CampusHR charge when an assignment has no costing? And on what date does Noor's record begin?
lines.say: What does Campus H R charge when an assignment has no costing? And on what date does Noor's record begin?

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Count Kai's jobs. Which one is he leaving, which one is primary, and what kind of pay calendar is he on?

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Is Vanderbilt's emeritus setup written down yet? And can a position ever move between worker types?

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Look past the label. Who decides how, when, and where this work gets done?

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Two settings carry the most risk in this kind of exit. Should you decide them alone?

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Read the letter closely. Which date is about the raise, and which is about the letter?

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Do you know yet what a FERDC appointment is and how it's set up? Who would?
lines.say: Do you know yet what an F E R D C appointment is and how it's set up? Who would?

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Which rules follow a person to the state where they actually work, and who needs to hear about it before the move?

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Whose rules apply to someone who works in another state, and who runs those programs?

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: When someone changes business units, does their costing reset or travel with them? And on which day does a pay period end?

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: When his absence ended, did anything change his assignment status? Which record tells payroll he's working?

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Which date starts the notice clock in a reduction in force, and how long does it run?

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Is this a question about one person, or about a whole area? Which tools fit each?

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You can make it easy for Marcus. You can't do it for him.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Which part of the I-9 is Noor's own, and when does each deadline start counting?
lines.say: Which part of the I nine is Noor's own, and when does each deadline start counting?

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: A normal two weeks is about 80 hours. Look for anything far from that.
lines.say: A normal two weeks is about eighty hours. Look for anything far from that.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: How do you make an approved absence stop counting, without leaving a second record behind?

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Whose job is it when the approver can't approve?

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Is a bonus part of base pay? And is $1,000 what she takes home, or what she's paid before taxes?
lines.say: Is a bonus part of base pay? And is one thousand dollars what she takes home, or what she's paid before taxes?

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Ask what the director actually needs for the meeting. It's often smaller than the request.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Dates move with weekends, holidays, and year end. Where would you check every time?

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Quick warm-up before the clock starts. This one isn't scored.

lines.speaker: mgr_ortiz
lines.text: You said my adjustment would be on this check. It isn't, and I'd already planned around it.

lines.speaker: mgr_ortiz
lines.text: Compensation says October isn't lost at all. It comes as retro in November. Why did you tell me it was?

lines.speaker: new_haddad
lines.text: I worked Wednesday through Friday before my official start, and none of it was on a time card. Am I getting paid for those days?

lines.speaker: new_haddad
lines.text: Marcus asked me to come in and shadow before my start date, and I worked three full days. Nobody said that wasn't paid.

lines.speaker: emp_nair
lines.text: Carmen called me the same day and walked me through everything before Dad's surgery. That was one less thing to worry about.

lines.speaker: emp_nair
lines.text: I didn't want to explain my dad's surgery at the HR desk. It felt like I had to prove he was sick enough.

lines.speaker: mgr_ortiz
lines.text: Priya's been out twice this week for her dad, and I've been counting it as PTO. Nobody told me it might be FMLA.

lines.speaker: leave_ruiz
lines.text: Priya says she asked your office about leave on Oct 19 and never heard back. The notice deadline has passed.
lines.say: Priya says she asked your office about leave on October nineteenth and never heard back. The notice deadline has passed.

lines.speaker: emp_nair
lines.text: My leave record says I'm out for a whole month, but I've only missed two days. Am I using up my leave?

lines.speaker: leave_ruiz
lines.text: Priya was out two days this week and none of it is recorded. I can't track her protected time if it only shows up at the end.

lines.speaker: emp_nair
lines.text: Dana asked how my dad's surgery went in front of the whole team. I never told her about it.

lines.speaker: emp_nair
lines.text: Dana asked me what kind of surgery my dad is having before she'd okay my days off. I felt like I had to justify it.

lines.speaker: emp_chen
lines.text: There's a $150 gift card on the event budget for Maya. If it paid for her hours, that's wages outside payroll, and I can't book it as a thank you.
lines.say: There's a one hundred fifty dollar gift card on the event budget for Maya. If it paid for her hours, that's wages outside payroll, and I can't book it as a thank you.

lines.speaker: ec_menon
lines.text: Maya's Student Expense Only record paid her for 12 hours of work. That setup isn't for wages, and she has no I-9.
lines.say: Maya's Student Expense Only record paid her for twelve hours of work. That setup isn't for wages, and she has no I nine.

lines.speaker: ec_menon
lines.text: Maya's record says service free stipend, but she worked 12 hours at the event. That's an employee with no I-9.
lines.say: Maya's record says service free stipend, but she worked twelve hours at the event. That's an employee with no I nine.

lines.speaker: pay_liu
lines.text: Maya's paid job is sitting under her student record, not an employee relationship. Payroll can't pay her hours like that.

lines.speaker: pay_liu
lines.text: Maya has two person records now, one as a student and one as an employee. We have to merge them before her pay is right.

lines.speaker: stu_brooks
lines.text: Aisha said I'd get paid for the event, but nobody ever set me up.

lines.speaker: emp_grant
lines.text: Maya couldn't work this week's event because she was waiting on a background check. I thought student workers didn't need one.

lines.speaker: ec_menon
lines.text: Maya has worked two events now with no I-9 on file. Every paid employee needs one, students too.
lines.say: Maya has worked two events now with no I nine on file. Every paid employee needs one, students too.

lines.speaker: mgr_ortiz
lines.text: Central HR sent the old Events Coordinator position back because of its job code. We lost two weeks, and there's still no posting.

lines.speaker: mgr_ortiz
lines.text: Central HR couldn't approve the update to the old position because of its retired job code. Now we're starting over with a new one.

lines.speaker: mgr_ortiz
lines.text: I asked about the Events Coordinator role on Monday. A week later, nothing has been requested.

lines.speaker: emp_chen
lines.text: The Events Coordinator position shows 1.0 FTE. I budgeted 0.75 for it, so my numbers don't match.
lines.say: The Events Coordinator position shows one point oh F T E. I budgeted point seven five for it, so my numbers don't match.

lines.speaker: mgr_ortiz
lines.text: The Events Coordinator position says 40 hours a week. If it posts that way, candidates will expect a full-time job.
lines.say: The Events Coordinator position says forty hours a week. If it posts that way, candidates will expect a full-time job.

lines.speaker: emp_chen
lines.text: There's a recruiting charge for three Events Coordinator openings. We have budget for one.

lines.speaker: rec_nguyen
lines.text: The Events Coordinator requisition came in as Unlimited with a United States location. I sent it back, so the posting slipped a week.

lines.speaker: pay_liu
lines.text: Mei is exempt, but her Friday off showed up on the time card system. It doesn't belong there, and her CampusHR balance never changed.
lines.say: Mei is exempt, but her Friday off showed up on the time card system. It doesn't belong there, and her Campus H R balance never changed.

lines.speaker: pay_liu
lines.text: I got an email about Mei's Friday off, but payroll doesn't enter absences. Nothing was ever recorded.

lines.speaker: mgr_ortiz
lines.text: Mei was out Friday and there's no absence on file. Her balance still shows that day.

lines.speaker: emp_chen
lines.text: My Friday off was approved before I left, and my balance is right. Easy.

lines.speaker: emp_chen
lines.text: My Friday off still says Awaiting approval. Did it ever count, or do I still have that day?

lines.speaker: emp_chen
lines.text: My balance went down two days for one Friday off.

lines.speaker: pay_liu
lines.text: Mei's day off is in CampusHR and on the time card system. She's exempt, so the time card entry has to come off.
lines.say: Mei's day off is in Campus H R and on the time card system. She's exempt, so the time card entry has to come off.

lines.speaker: dir_park
lines.text: The grant report went in on time, and nobody's Social Security number left this office. Good call.

lines.speaker: dir_park
